name: Nutrition Plan Extension
description: Capture a grocery product page into the Notion Ingredients DB — add it as a new row, or replace an existing one. Internal tool.
comment_permissions: activeTab + scripting let the popup inject dist/content.js into the CURRENT tab on demand (only when you click the extension), so capture works on ANY shop without a hardcoded host list. No broad host_permissions for reading page CONTENT by default. The SIDE PANEL stays open across navigation and has no per-open activeTab grant: 'tabs' lets it see the active tab's URL (metadata only) so it can name the vendor + dup-check as you browse, and reading page CONTENT there needs the optional_host_permissions it asks for once via its banner.
comment_host_permissions: api.notion.com for the Ingredients DB; api.anthropic.com for the macro lookup behind 'Add to Ingredients'. Both are called ONLY from the background worker, which host_permissions exempts from CORS.
